## [This is a marketing company, not a service one](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/65dfe6965ba46bb5e9bc72f0)
Products are usually decent, but no support number, no email, just a form, which takes days to respond to, leaving a customer experience FAR below expectations. Service does not match branding. It’s clear what they value, and where they put their money, and it’s marketing, not customer experience.

February 28, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Feb 29, 2024

Thank you for your feedback. We're here to help and provide support from 9 am to 5 pm through our live chat with a representative. For any additional inquiries, please don't hesitate to contact us at support@luluandgeorgia.com. We're committed to enhancing your experience with us and appreciate your input.
